The results of calculations were compared with experimental data of oblique ionosphere sounding obtained by chirp ionosonde on paths Magadan - Irkutsk, Khabarovsk - Irkutsk and Norilsk - Irkutsk.
GNSS observations from the CM01 receiver are analyzed to characterize temporal variations in TEC during selected geomagnetic storm events and background quiet periods.
